name: Akira
source:
Likes: Aestheticism, Yoshimasa
Dislikes: Ugliness
Hobby: Shopping, Make-up
Home: Hokuto Island

Beautiful outside, strong on the inside.

Growing up with Yoshimasa, Akira has devoted his whole life to protecting him. His ancestor is Shizuka, whose life was saved by Yoshitsune Minamoto.

His appearance attracts everyone regardless of genders. He is proud of his look and loves beautification. He is generally nice to people, but he fights against anyone that harms Yoshimasa.

He once lived in the Hidden Village of Yamato Island, where he befriended with Shiroya.

[From in-game profile]
